primary_evaluation.outcome: 81/84 completions, 12/12 nominal, zero witnessed failures and recoveries; original recovery competence gate remains failed.

question: Can the frozen learned policy recover after a physically witnessed failed insertion, rather than only prevent the initial failure?

prefix.source: The unchanged RetrySettings.first_attempt_s=4.0; before this time retry and continued insertion have identical actions.
prefix.selection_reason: Existing frozen retry traces already show 17 witnessed contact failures by four seconds. No new prefix duration or controller tuning was selected from learned-policy recovery outcomes.
prefix.handoff: Fixed time only, independent of evaluator contact, hidden state and learned outcomes.
prefix.learned_arm: Unchanged scripted insertion for the first 60 controls, then the frozen Gaussian mean for the remainder.
prefix.retry_arm: Unchanged retry controller for the entire job; its first possible retry starts after the shared prefix.
prefix.continue_arm: Unchanged continued-insertion controller for the entire job.

metrics: All-request completion, upstream predicate, force abort, deadline, lost grasp, time and full returns
Prefix scripted completions and prefix failed jobs separately
Witnessed failures active at handoff, post-handoff completions and post-handoff witnessed withdrawals followed by completed dwell
All shared-prefix physical/action arrays and sensor randomness bitwise matched
Retry full trajectory identical to existing frozen positive control
scope_and_limitations: This is a separate development assay, not a replacement for the completed primary evaluation or its gate.
Prefix completions belong to the scripted prefix, not the learned controller. All prefix failures remain in the full-job denominator.
One development seed cannot establish robust recovery, a curriculum advantage, hardware transfer or publication novelty.
No adaptive training will be launched based solely on this supplemental assay.
